versions.changelog:
Initial release of ai-newsletter-daily

- Generates a daily AI news newsletter for Chinese readers using the latest online sources.
- Summarizes each news item in Simplified Chinese, optimized for AI practitioners.
- Includes extensive filtering (duplication, domain, topic relevance, etc.) and fallback retrieval for reliable coverage.
- Outputs both a markdown-format newsletter and structured JSON containing summaries, metadata, and warnings.
- Requires BRAVE_API_KEY (for web search) and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY (for article fetching).
